speaker: Doctor
text: Does the infant have any difficulty swallowing solids or liquids, and has he experienced any episodes of turning blue or stopping breathing? I will also request a detailed review of his feeding mechanics. REQUEST TEST: Barium Swallow Study.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Double Aortic Arch causing a Vascular Ring.
